ITEM 1 | Pale green cubed fruit flesh, pieces about 2-3 cm, smooth moist surface with slightly netted rind edges, light sheen, arranged in a cluster on the upper-left of a white square plate; covers roughly 20% of plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Bright yellow cubed fruit with pale edges, pieces about 2 cm, moist and firm-looking, a few chunks on the upper-center and right of the plate; covers roughly 8% of plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Bright red cubed fruit with dark green rind edges, pieces about 2 cm, juicy looking with slight wet sheen, scattered in a cluster lower-left of plate; covers roughly 15% of plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Golden-yellow pineapple-type wedges, triangular pieces about 3 cm long and 1 cm thick, moist surface, sitting in a row center-right of plate; covers roughly 7% of plate | 50
ITEM 5 | Cooked bacon strips, brown to dark reddish-brown, crisp and browned edges with some charred spots, glossy rendered fat sheen, flat strips about 1 cm wide and 8-10 cm long, lying across the lower-right of the plate; covers roughly 10% of plate | 40
